text:
You’re not undoing your recovery. Three pizza nights do not erase the work you’ve done.

What now:

| Next 24–48 h | Focus |
|---|---|
| Next meal | Eat normally, don’t “make up” for it |
| Today | Get protein at each meal |
| Today | Add one calcium-rich food |
| Today | Have fruit/veg once or twice |
| Today | Drink water and keep it simple |

Recovery is about the average, not one rough stretch. Pizza is just food. The move now is to get back to boring, solid basics and keep healing.

If you want, I can give you a no-fuss recovery day menu in metric.

attributes.reason: Reassuring and low-pressure, with no pushy or demanding tone.
Centers on recovery and getting back to basics rather than performance or punishment.
Uses a clear table to organize the next steps, matching the requested structured format.
